Meta to cut ~8,000 jobs (10% of workforce) starting May 20, with more layoffs planned for H2 2026 as AI restructuring accelerates
JPMorgan downgraded META to Neutral and cut price target to $725, citing intensifying full-stack AI competition and uncertain capex ROI

OpenAI and Google remain the primary rivals for Meta's AI model ambitions; Meta's new 'Muse Spark' model is a direct attempt to close the gap. TikTok/ByteDance remains the top social media threat, driving continued Instagram Reels investment. Sources: CNBC, Fortune, Bloomberg.
